headline: Kansas City plays on after UCLA halts Omaha
dek: Kansas City drew with Stanford and enters its meeting with Vermont with eleven wins and only three defeats, the sole Summit program still on the schedule. On the same evening, UCLA beat Omaha again, halting a run that had carried Omaha past Creighton.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Across all matches, goals split the conference into an upper and a lower half, and Omaha's 48 are more than Oral Roberts and St. Thomas have scored together.

wire.line: Omaha leads the Summit with twelve wins, but Kansas City tops the table and is the lone program still playing.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date without a published result.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mark Ramarola, a defender, has seven goals and six assists for Kansas City.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kamy Ndione has kept seven shutouts in Omaha's goal.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oral Roberts has drawn more matches than it has won, six to four.

last_match.line: UCLA had already beaten Omaha in September, and the defeat ended Omaha's winning run.

next_match.line: Vermont beat UMass in September, and Kansas City enters the match unbeaten since its October defeat at Omaha.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
